purpose: Disabled-by-default dry-run plan for checking locally supplied/quarantined donor sources before any prototype asset bake is allowed.

notes: Blocked/non-commercial/unverified sources may stay visible as donor/reference catalog records, but the bake path must refuse them.
This pass intentionally does not process image pixels or generate processed atlases.

safetyNotes: The dry-run command may read manifests and check for locally supplied archives/sheets, but it must not copy raw third-party assets into repo runtime paths.
The bake report is safe to commit because it records availability/status only, not asset pixels.
A later real bake pass must still require explicit source approval, attribution metadata, and no-standalone-export release gates.
